results.question: How many trips were there in total?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(trips) AS total_trips FROM gold_daily_summary

results.question: What is the total fare collected across all days?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS total_fare FROM gold_daily_summary

results.question: Which date had the most trips?
results.sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which date had the fewest trips?
results.sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY trips ASC LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY trips ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many distinct days are in the data?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_date) AS distinct_days FROM gold_daily_summary

results.question: Which pickup zip had the most trips overall?
results.sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY SUM(trips) DESC LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY SUM(trips) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 pickup zips by total fare?
results.sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY SUM(total_fare) DESC LIMIT 3
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY SUM(total_fare) DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: How many distinct pickup zips are there?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_zip) AS distinct_pickup_zips FROM gold_daily_zone_stats

results.question: What was the maximum number of active pickup zips on any single day?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(active_pickup_zips) AS max_active_pickup_zips FROM gold_daily_summary

results.question: Which pickup zip has the highest average trip distance, counting only zips with at least 50 trips in total?
results.sql:
SELECT pickup_zip
FROM gold_daily_zone_stats
GROUP BY pickup_zip
HAVING SUM(trips) >= 50
ORDER BY SUM(avg_distance * trips) / SUM(trips) DESC
LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip HAVING SUM(trips) >= 50 ORDER BY SUM(avg_distance * trips) / SUM(trips) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: On which date was the average fare highest?
results.sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the largest number of trips from a single pickup zip on a single day?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(trips) AS max_trips FROM gold_daily_zone_stats

results.question: What is the average number of trips per day?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(trips) AS avg_trips_per_day FROM gold_daily_summary

results.question: What is the average fare per trip across all days, weighted by the number of trips?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(total_fare) / SUM(trips) AS weighted_avg_fare FROM gold_daily_summary
